notes.title: Cantaloupe Chronicle - Available now!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]with great pleasure I announce that my newest game "Cantaloupe Chronicle" is now available on Steam for Windows and Linux.[/p][p][/p][p]In Cantaloupe Chronicle, you step into the shoes of a budding journalist on your first day as an intern at the town’s quirky newspaper, The Cantaloupe Chronicle. Set in a cozy roadside town filled with intrigue, this game invites you to explore a rich, atmospheric environment. Interact with eccentric locals, solve puzzles, and uncover stories that will shape your career as a reporter.[/p][p]The story centers on an old mystery, but the theme explores how not every story ends cleanly and how we learn to live without closure.[/p][p]What begins as a simple learning experience quickly turns into a quest to uncover the secrets of the town's past—including the mysterious case of a body found years ago.[/p][p]As you collect items, talk to the townsfolk, and solve engaging puzzles, you’ll craft articles using an innovative text editor system. Writing doesn’t feel daunting here—you can unlock text blocks from your investigations and insert them into articles with ease. From small-town gossip to the big front-page story, every article brings them closer to the ultimate truth.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p] Tim[/p]

notes.title: Update 4.0.4. - Update not Found :D
notes.content:
Just kidding,
another QoL and bug fix update.

Most notable change: I've decided to remove the Quantum Matrix Scanner from the inventory. The item caused a lot of confusion without actually being needed to solve any of the puzzles. All items are now "scanned" automatically and have the superposition on the item's description.

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Changes in 4.0.3
notes.content:

notes.title: New Update: Achievements and More
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

just updated the game. There are a few more lines of dialog in there to better support the story and some new responses when you try to do something that makes sense but isn't the correct answer to a puzzle.

And I've also added a whole whoop of 33 achievements to the game. Can you unlock them all? ^^

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Day 4 Release - Zarathustra is Complete!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm happy to announce that Day4 of Zarathustra - Cybergeddon has just been made available for download.

The final day of the adventure concludes our story and brings the case to a close.

It also features many bug-fixes and smaller QoL improvements like mouse-drag scrolling on the map and savegames being sorted by date.

Have fun playing!

Cheers,
 Tim
